_comment: workflow-register (DR-1342): the total line count of .github/workflows may only go DOWN; re-freeze lower with `node scripts/workflow-register.mjs --generate`. To RAISE it, edit by hand with a one-line reason here.

raises.reason: A required guard step in ci.yml for subprocess-budget-guard: one `- run:` line, four comment lines and a blank separator. The guard must be in ci.yml and not only verify:gates, because a guard CI never runs is not a guard (DR-0076 section 3) -- verify-covers-ci-guards.test.js fails the build without it. The original comment was 17 lines and was folded to four with the narrative in the record, so this is the irreducible cost of the step rather than its first draft.

One NEW workflow, lesson-mail-label.yml (114 lines), which gives the DR-0312 capture lock a road a runner can walk -- it had never been set on a single built thread because the only road stopped for a human approval on every call. The ceiling exists to refuse BLOAT, not to refuse capability; this is a whole new step of an existing Way, not a longer version of one. Its first draft was 119 lines and its header was folded to 17 with the narrative moved into the record and session note, so this is the step's cost and not its first draft. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

Nine lines in lesson-mail-label.yml so a DORMANT run that was asked to label threads exits 1 instead of 0: the error line naming the label, the thread count, where the secret comes from and that lesson-mail-watch.yml needs the same one, plus the comment recording that the first live dispatch went GREEN having laboured on nothing. The ceiling refuses bloat, not a safeguard being made able to fail loudly -- the alternative was a log line and a green run, which is what this corrects. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

source-transcript-nas.yml gains a more_video_ids input so a burst of links is one run instead of five dispatches that cancel each other (measured 2026-11-06: two of five cancelled by the concurrency group). One comment line and four input lines; the narrative is in the record.

loops-health.yml now READS the nas-heartbeat loop (its last-run.json in its own home, install path, cron prefix, a red on a ledger that says the row could not be written, and a dark-loop diagnosis line): the a-service-comes-home gate refused the services.json entry until the witness actually looked. Twelve lines, four of them the comment that names why the ledger exists; raised to the measured total, not above it.

A required guard step in ci.yml for forward-safe-gate-guard: one `- run:` line and two comment lines. It must be in ci.yml and not only verify:gates, because a guard CI never runs is not a guard (DR-0076 section 3) and verify-covers-ci-guards.test.js fails the build without it. Three lines is the step's cost: the narrative lives in the record and the guard's own header, not in the YAML. First written as 22396 -> 22399 against the main of the hour; after merging main (ll284 and the proof-of-work record raised it to 22413) the same three lines are 22413 -> 22416, which is the measured total and not above it.

Every tailnet join in the repo now goes through .github/actions/join-tailnet, which VERIFIES the join by asking tailscale itself rather than trusting the step's conclusion (DR-1284). 68 join sites across 64 workflows passed secrets.TS_AUTHKEY directly, so one key failure shut 68 roads at once -- measured again on inbox-lessons-waiting run 42709659655, which failed at 'Verify the tailnet actually joined'. The growth is the door's input lines per site plus a sparse actions/checkout at the 21 sites that had none (a local composite action cannot be read without a checkout, measured before converting, which is the only reason those 21 did not break). The oauth-* inputs are DORMANT: DR-1360 withdrew the OAuth client as the fix and governs. First written as 22413 -> 22659 against the main of the hour; after merging main (DR-1363's three lines raised it to 22416) the same change is 22416 -> 22662, which is the measured total and not above it.

Two dormant lanes are given a voice. lesson-mail-watch.yml had 480 runs from 2026-08-25 to 2026-11-09, every sampled one an honest no-op exiting 0, so 77 days of a shut Gmail door were visible only in the raw log of run 480; the dormant branch now also emits a ::warning:: and a step summary naming what it costs and the one value that fixes it. nas-email-door.yml reports SMTP_APP_PASSWORD presence BEFORE its tailnet gate, because that fact does not depend on the tailnet and was unreachable behind a dead TS_AUTHKEY -- it decides whether a dark lane is a wiring fix or a value only Darrell can mint (DR-1159). The growth is almost entirely the comments that record the 480-run measurement and name this as the WEAK fix, with the rolling-issue ledger (DR-0125's shape) as the dated follow-up; raised to the measured total, not above it.

loops-health.yml gains its second road (DR-1360): the join carries continue-on-error, and one step reads the heartbeat the NAS writes itself over poetech.us/sb when the box could not be asked over SSH, writing the same witness the judge, report and incident steps already read. Three lines of comment, five of step, one flag, two small judge edits; the narrative is in the record. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

0319's smoke must be run by a leg (rls-isolation-matrix-guard refuses an orphan smoke) and proven on a bare Postgres in CI: a three-line leg in rls-isolation.yml and a two-line step in ci.yml's withdraw-walls job, folded to one run line with no comment, the narrative in the record. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

One NEW workflow, exposure-report.yml (58 lines): Darrell asked for workflows that keep us secure without undermining our processes, reporting the conditions before any fix, inside the app. It ranks every known vulnerability in what we ship by the four elements and publishes the report the Exposure strip reads; it is report only (no fix, no PR, no push), one run at a time, ten minutes at most. A whole new capability, not a longer version of one; its header carries the read-only promise the tests pin. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

ci.yml did not parse from 29dc042 on: a one-line `run:` held 'SMOKE: PASS', a colon and a space in a plain YAML value, so GitHub ran no ci.yml job on four pushes and nothing showed red. The step becomes a block (+2), and a new workflow, workflows-parse.yml (31 lines), parses every workflow on any change to them; it cannot live inside the file it guards, because a file that does not parse runs nothing. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

The NAS's two witnesses are gated. Neither infra/nas-loops/test_heartbeat.py nor the new test_lesson_queue_census.py was run by CI: both test files existed and nothing executed them, which is the brake-without-a-witness shape this repo keeps finding. One step now runs both, and the comment above it records WHY the census test matters most: it parses scripts/lesson-inbox-waiting.sql and fails if the loop's exclusion list drifts from the lane's, because a census taken on 2026-11-10 dropped not-a-lesson and withdrawn and so counted rows a person had taken back (DR-1142, DR-0725). Raised to the measured size, not above it.

loops-health.yml now READS the lesson-queue-census loop, exactly as it was made to read nas-heartbeat: its last-run.json in its own home, its install path, its `lesson-queue-census:` cron lines, a red when that ledger says the count could not be written, and a line in the dark-loop diagnosis. The a-service-comes-home gate caught the services.json entry with the loop on NEITHER list and failed the first push of PR #2604 by name -- doing its job -- and a name beside a witness that never looks at it is the hollow version of walking the Way, so the witness was made to look first. Sixteen lines, six of them the comment recording that this ledger carries counts and never a person's words. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

inbox-lessons-waiting.yml gains its second road (DR-1360/DR-1399's shape): the join carries continue-on-error, one step reads the lesson-queue census the NAS takes for itself over poetech.us/sb when the tailnet is shut, the run log reports WHICH road answered, and a closing step fails the job when NEITHER road read the queue. That last step is the reason this is not pure growth: making both read steps continue-on-error is exactly how a lane starts reporting success for work it did not do, so the brake had to ship with the capability. MEASURED cause: runs #500-#505 -- six consecutive firings of the PRIORITY lesson lane -- all died at the join on a key that expired 2026-11-04 and again by 11-10, while the queue sat on a machine that was up and the census that counts it had been running all along, unreadable from outside for the same reason. The ceiling refuses bloat, not a road that removes a single point of failure. First written at 22973; the three comment blocks were folded to 10, 11 and 8 lines (-21) with the narrative moved into the record, so this is the mechanism's cost and not its first draft. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

The PoeTech+ checkout. poetech-plus-keys.yml (80 lines) turns the one value only Darrell holds, his Stripe secret key, into the whole go-live DR-0263 left to his hand: it makes the $39/month Price (refusing any other amount), the webhook with its signing secret and the cancel portal, installs the Pages secrets, redeploys and proves the live site offers PoeTech+. A LIVE key is refused unless the dispatch types CHARGE-REAL-MONEY. ci.yml +4 runs the 0321 smoke (a member reads only their own row and cannot grant a tier) and rls-isolation.yml +3 adds it to the matrix. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

Bishop Gwin's messages become lessons from the NAS's side. ci.yml +1 runs test_bg_message_lessons (a message with no named speaker is never sent as his; a message is sent once); loops-health.yml +1 reads the new loop's own last-run.json in the diagnosis, beside its name in the loops list, install map, cron prefix and heartbeat receipt (edited on existing lines). Raised to the measured total, not above it.

poetech-plus-keys.yml runs daily as well as by hand (Darrell: should he have to do this later, or can it be automated for consistency). +19 lines: the schedule, and a gate step that makes a daily run do nothing when no key is set, nothing when the live site already offers PoeTech+, and never install a live key (that still needs a dispatch typing CHARGE-REAL-MONEY), with every later step gated on it. So the one paste of his key is the only hand ever needed, and a lost Pages environment heals itself. Raised to the measured total, not above it.

Raised to the measured total, not above it. Re-froze at 23062 after merging main (DR-1443's PR landed fewer YAML lines than it replaced), so the ceiling sits at the measured total, not at the raise.

A required guard step in ci.yml for re-review-ratchet-guard: one `- run:` line and two comment lines. It must be in ci.yml and not only verify:gates, because a guard CI never runs is not a guard (DR-0076 section 3) -- verify-covers-ci-guards.test.js fails the build without it. The comment is two lines, the same shape as the reviewer-lens step beside it, with the narrative in the guard's own header and DR-1444. Raised to the measured total, not above it.
